cd /workspace/tmp && cat > rusage_test.py <<'EOF'
import resource, subprocess, sys, time, os
# child: pure python busy loop with known CPU cost, plus z3 checks with timeout
code = '''
import z3, time
s = z3.Solver()
TO = int(%s)
if TO: s.set('timeout', TO)
x = z3.Int('x'); s.add(x>=0, x<=1000000)
t0=time.time()
n=0
while time.time()-t0 < 3.0:
    s.push(); s.add(x <= 500000 + (n%%1000)); s.check(); s.pop(); n+=1
print(n, file=__import__('sys').stderr)
'''
for to in (0, 20000):
    r0 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    t0 = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', code % to], capture_output=True, text=True)
    wall = time.time()-t0
    r1 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    print('timeout=%5d wall=%.2f  child user=%.2f sys=%.2f  (checks=%s)' % (
        to, wall, r1.ru_utime-r0.ru_utime, r1.ru_stime-r0.ru_stime, p.stderr.strip()))
EOF
timeout 120 python3 rusage_test.py; echo "=== and with /usr/bin/time -v style accounting ==="; timeout 60 bash -c 'time python3 -c "

t0=time.time(); n=0

"'
